tools.name: axi_board_run
tools.description: Run an AXI transaction program on the board's transactor design (designs/b59a_axi_tx, SRAM only, by the local board file's cable serial), with operating conditions logged before and after. Needs stage configuration-and-debug, a passing power_ok for that build, and hardware budget.

program.description: A transaction program (axi_tx/host/program.py): a mapping with name, target (bram | periph), optional lite_bug / stream_bug, and steps; or the same as YAML text.

tools.name: axi_program_check
tools.description: Assemble an AXI transaction program for the on-chip transactor (axi_tx) and run its transaction-level model: the instruction count, the disassembly and the predicted transactions and verdict counters. No simulator, no board.

program.description: A transaction program (axi_tx/host/program.py): a mapping with name, target (bram | periph), optional lite_bug / stream_bug, and steps; or the same as YAML text.

tools.name: axi_simulate
tools.description: Run an AXI transaction program on the transactor RTL in simulation (cocotb + Icarus: the transactor, the protocol checkers, the scoreboard, our AXI4-Lite peripheral, a memory model and the stream FIFO), through the same host code as the board. Returns verdicts, rule counts, coverage and latency counters.

program.description: A transaction program (axi_tx/host/program.py): a mapping with name, target (bram | periph), optional lite_bug / stream_bug, and steps; or the same as YAML text.

tools.name: board_constraints
tools.description: Write design.xdc from the board's resource names; you never write pin numbers. 'map' is a list of {resource, port}: resource is a board resource (clk100, led[0:15], sw[0:15], seg, an, btnc, uart_rx, ...; name, name[i] or name[a:b]), port is YOUR design's port name (a bus name for a range, or name[i] for one bit of a bus). Pins, I/O standards and the create_clock on the board clock come from the board's master XDC. With no 'map', returns the board's resource list.

tools.name: bringup
tools.description: Run the design's bring-up on the board: program base, UART tests against the blind model, program ila, ILA captures, check the design is still alive (flow/bringup.py). Same preconditions as program.

tools.name: build
tools.description: Run the Vivado flow (flow/run_vivado.sh, memory-capped) up to a stage, then the stage gates. until: synth (post_synth reports), place, route (post_route reports), bitstream. variant ila (debug cores from probes.yaml) always runs to the bitstream.

tools.name: check_constraints
tools.description: Check design.xdc against the board: clocks only on the board's clock input, no CLOCK_DEDICATED_ROUTE FALSE, pins and I/O standards as in the master XDC, commands in the XDC allow-list.

tools.name: debug_capture
tools.description: Capture on the attached board with a plan from debug_plan: programs the plan's debug ILA build (SRAM only), sets up registers, arms, sends the stimulus, uploads, reads the XADC conditions, and answers in plain words from the capture. build=true makes the debug build first if none holds the probes (a Vivado run of several minutes). Needs stage configuration-and-debug, power_ok and hardware budget. Returns the answer, facts and the capture path, not raw samples.

build.description: make the debug build first if none holds the probes (a Vivado run)

tools.name: debug_plan
tools.description: Plan a logic-analyser capture on the board (vendor ILA, Basic licence tier: one clock domain, at most 5 probe ports, one comparator per port, so each OR term needs its own port; the planner arranges this). Give the request as structured intent; signal names are resolved against the RTL (registers by hierarchical name, e.g. u_dut.count, or a probes.yaml name); unknown names come back as errors with suggestions. Returns the plan in plain words and its probeset id. Builds nothing.

intent.description: the request in the intent schema: {probes: [names], trigger: {combine: AND|OR, conditions: [{signal, op (== != < <= > >= rise fall change), value}]}, pre, post, setup, stimulus, readback: [{op: write|read|wait_ms, register, value, ms}], question}

request.description: the request in words, kept for the record

tools.name: debug_query
tools.description: Ask a question of a capture without reading its samples: op value_at {channel, cycle}; first {channel, cmp, value, from_cycle}; count {channel, cmp, value}; changes {channel, limit}; runs {channel, value}; summary; diverge (with other: a second capture of the same probes, e.g. simulation) -> the first cycle where they differ. Cycles are relative to the trigger (cycle 0).

capture.description: the capture path under build/debug/ that debug_capture returned

other.description: a second capture of the same probes, for op diverge

tools.name: formal
tools.description: Run the design's SymbiYosys jobs (verif/formal/*.sby): bounded proof and cover.

tools.name: gates
tools.description: Parse a build's reports into stage results (flow/gates.py), run the verification stage gates (flow/verif_gates.py: with the proof-method traceability table), check the design standards (flow/standards_check.py: rule ids, with the post-synthesis rules read from build/<variant>), check architecture.yaml and its approval (architecture), or check the bring-up artefacts without the board (bringup_ready). Raw numbers and rule ids only.

tools.name: lint
tools.description: Verilator --lint-only -Wall on the design (the build.yaml sources).

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files under a directory inside the design directory, or @shell/ (read-only test shell view); at most 500 entries.

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Load the frozen bank's skills for this board and family, filtered to bank section ids (SECTIONS.yaml), or one skill by name (brief 36). Returns SKILL.md text as data.

tools.name: mutate
tools.description: Mutation testing of the design's RTL (V3 mutation_score_pct): runs tests/test_*_rtl.py against a capped, seeded sample of mutated copies of rtl/ (operator and constant changes, or verif/mutants.yaml) and writes build/verif/mutation.json for gates(kind=verif). A mutant is killed only when a test fails; surviving mutants come back in plain words (file, line, the change) so you can add checks that catch them. It is a heavy job (minutes): it takes the machine's heavy-job lock and returns busy=true, with 'busy, retry', when another job holds it.

tools.name: program
tools.description: Program the attached board's SRAM (never flash) with the base or ila bitstream, selected by the board's cable serial from the local board file. Needs stage configuration-and-debug, a passing power_ok for the recorded power source, a current build stamp, and hardware budget.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file inside the design directory (any path, including build/ outputs), or the test shell read-only under @shell/ (@shell/rtl/..., @shell/PROTOCOL.md, @shell/host/protocol.py).

tools.name: report
tools.description: Read a named Vivado report or log from build/<variant>/ (for example timing_summary.rpt, power.rpt).

tools.name: report_digest
tools.description: A typed digest of a named Vivado report or log from build/<variant>/, computed by the flow's own parsers (no model). level=summary: the verdict and key numbers; standard: plus the top 5 paths and one example per rule ID; detail: plus the top 20 paths and every rule instance. focus: a path index, a rule ID, a clock pair (clk_a,clk_b) or a test name. The digest ends with the report's path; `report` reads the raw text.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: BM25 search of the frozen documentation library (no web). Returns chunks as data.

tools.name: simulate
tools.description: Run the design's cocotb tests (tests/test_*_rtl.py) under the chosen simulator. sim=auto (the default) uses Verilator, which is faster (1.8x to 3.2x on two measured benches), when it is available and the design builds in it, and otherwise Icarus; the harness cross-checks on Icarus before a stage passes. coverage=true (with sim=verilator) also records line/toggle/cover-property coverage (coverage.dat per seed), which gates(kind=verif) needs for the code-coverage checks.

tools.name: skill_excerpt
tools.description: One section of one skill: the text under a heading of its SKILL.md (exact heading or a unique prefix). Without a match, lists the skill's headings.

tools.name: skill_index
tools.description: Rank the frozen bank's skills for a query (names, sections and one-line descriptions, no bodies). Then load_skill(name=...) for one body or skill_excerpt(name, heading) for one section.

tools.name: spec_items
tools.description: List the spec items the test plan must trace (verif/testplan.yaml requirements[].spec), by the exact ids the V1 gate checks, each with its spec text. Read from spec.yaml.

tools.name: stage_note
tools.description: Append a note to the design's build note (BUILD_NOTE.md) and move the session to a stage.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write (create or replace) a text file inside the design directory. build/ is read-only. Known artefacts (spec.yaml, verif/testplan.yaml, build.yaml, ARCHITECTURE.md, any *.yaml) are checked first: a malformed one is NOT written and the error names the line and column.
